candidate: M1 logical-C1 physical-C2 shadow, T2 production experiment
ready_prerequisites: exact provider request clone with physical fingerprint parity

blocker.name: public_request_equals_physical_lane_in_batch_executor
blocker.reason: Every physical lane is assumed to be a public scheduler request. A shadow has no public row and must compute while being excluded from acceptance, commit ownership, telemetry, cancellation publication, and output IDs.
blocker.unsafe_shortcut: fabricating a negative-ID scheduler row would violate exact request/slot/commit ownership
blocker.required_refactor: separate physical target lanes from public request IDs and add explicit compute/publish/commit masks through verify, accept, selected-state commit, cancellation, compaction, and telemetry

decision: Do not enable B3. Retain current C1 strict fallback and record implementation/full T2 packet as blocked until the physical-lane/public-request separation exists.
